messages.content: Rewrite plain English in the manner of Hegel's writing, as his nineteenth-century English translators render it. Keep the content exactly: every claim, example and step, in the same order, and add nothing.

Rewrite in Hegel's manner:

The food is finished, and the obligation of the body is discharged. Masterji has returned to his work, the shears moving in the rhythm of a practical spirit. I am not yet ready to leave this horseshoe of needs; the air is cooling, and I have the energy for one more movement before the file's shadow returns.
